decisions.notes: Pinned directly in package.json; no transitive copies. Solutions range from 4.17.21 through 4.17.23 up to 4.18.0; 4.18.1 satisfies the strictest fix (template imports / CVE-2026-4800) and the 4.17.23+ unset/omit patch line. This is a minor semver step within major 4 (4.17 → 4.18), not a major bump. Fix path matches existing practice: change the direct dependency version and run npm install to update package-lock.json. Blast radius is limited to call sites of lodash APIs in this small gateway; 4.18.x remains the lodash 4 API surface.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive via `spring-boot-starter-logging`. Conditional-config ACE needs Janino and writable config; low practical risk for this sample. Override `logback.version` (Maven property / Gradle `ext`) matching existing Tomcat/Thymeleaf overrides, or absorb via a newer Boot BOM.

Transitive through `spring-boot-starter-json`. App is servlet MVC (not WebFlux), so async-parser DoS paths are less exposed but the library is still on the classpath. Raise managed Jackson BOM to 2.21.7+ via Boot upgrade or `jackson-bom.version` override.

Managed with jackson-core. Several issues need polymorphic typing, `@JsonView`/`@JsonUnwrapped`, or untrusted binding to exotic types; Petclinic uses typical REST/JPA DTOs, but upgrade stays warranted. Align databind with jackson-core at 2.21.7 through the BOM.
Pulled in by `spring-boot-starter-actuator`. DoS via crafted HTTP/gRPC metrics traffic. Patch release on the 1.15 line; should ride Boot 3.5.12+ BOM or `micrometer.version` property override.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive from Spring Boot logging bridges; Boot defaults to Logback, so MapMessage JSON layout impact is unlikely unless JsonTemplateLayout is configured. Bump `log4j2.version` / Boot BOM to at least 2.25.5.

Declared `runtimeOnly` / `runtime` without an explicit version; version comes from the Boot BOM. Only used when `postgres` profile is active. Set `postgresql.version` to 42.7.12 in both builds (same pattern as `tomcat.version` overrides).

Core Boot jar is transitive from starters, not declared on its own. `ApplicationTemp` / persistent sessions issue needs local attacker and `server.servlet.session.persistent=true` (not default). Fix by raising Gradle Boot plugin and Maven parent to 3.5.15+.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Transitive from all starters. Embedded Artemis predictable path is irrelevant unless Artemis auto-config runs (not used here). Still fixed in Boot 3.5.15; upgrade parent/plugin version.

Direct runtime dependency; `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=*` widens actuator attack surface. Health-group / Cloud Foundry path auth-bypass fixes ship in Boot 3.5.12+; prefer 3.5.15 to align with other Boot CVEs.

From `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa`. Sort/property-path DoS affects apps accepting attacker-controlled sort or projection parameters. Fixed in Spring Data 3.5.12 via Boot BOM bump (no separate direct declaration).

BOM-managed Spring Framework module. Annotation detection bug matters if `@EnableMethodSecurity` is used on generic hierarchies; Petclinic does not appear to use method security. Upgrade via Boot release that imports Framework 6.2.11+ or `spring-framework.version` override.
SpEL DoS requires evaluating attacker-controlled expressions; typical Petclinic controllers do not. Still remediate with Framework 6.2.19 through Boot BOM or `spring-framework.version`.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: RFD via non-ASCII `ContentDisposition` filename and SSRF via `UriComponentsBuilder` host parsing need user-influenced headers/URLs. 6.2.19 covers the newer SSRF fix; RFD fixed in 6.2.8+. Align entire Framework stack to 6.2.19.

decisions.reason: no safe version bump is available
decisions.notes: Vendor lists CVE-2026-47884 (XsltView RCE) and CVE-2026-47890 (SSE stream corruption) fixes only on Framework 7.0.9; remaining findings have 6.2.10–6.2.19 fixes. Petclinic uses Thymeleaf on embedded Tomcat (not XSLT views, not Windows static FS, not WebFlux), lowering exploitability but not scanner status. Full remediation is a major Spring Boot 4 / Framework 7 upgrade; interim 6.2.19 via Boot 3.5.x addresses non-CRITICAL items only.

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Direct entry in go.mod; app uses mongo.NewClient and BSON APIs in configs/ and controllers/. Patch is a large v1 jump (1.11→1.17) but major version stays 1. CVE is in optional CGo GSSAPI/Kerberos auth—low runtime risk if SCRAM/standard URI auth only. After bump, run go mod tidy and regression-test Mongo connectivity; watch for deprecations (e.g. NewClient vs Connect).

decisions.reason: severity MEDIUM is outside the auto-remediate set
decisions.notes: Indirect in go.mod; pulled by gin stack, validator, and mongo-driver. CVEs affect golang.org/x/crypto/ssh DoS—not used directly by this Gin API unless something imports ssh. Safe fix: go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.56.0 (minimal minor within 0.x module line).

Indirect in go.mod; unified to v0.57.0 via MVS from gin, validator, mimetype, and x/crypto. Fixes span html parser DoS/XSS and multiple http2 issues relevant to net/http servers/clients (Gin). Highest fixed version across findings is 0.62.0. Use go get golang.org/x/net@v0.62.0 and retest HTTP serving.

Transitive: direct dependency axios@1.20.0 (^1.16.0) and dev-only http-proxy@1.18.1 (^1.0.0). Runtime exposure is the Vue client HTTP stack. axios semver already allows 1.16.2; npm update follow-redirects or lockfile refresh in vue-js should resolve without overrides. Patch-level bump.

Transitive via postcss@8.4.19 (^3.3.4). Only exercised if build tooling calls nanoid with attacker-controlled size/alphabet; not a direct app dependency. Stay on 3.x line (3.3.18 satisfies all listed 3.x fix floors; avoids nanoid 5 major). Lockfile refresh/npm update nanoid is sufficient.

Transitive dev dependency from @vue/cli-service@5.0.8 and webpack/css pipeline (^8.x ranges allow 8.5.23). CVEs matter when untrusted CSS is processed (path traversal/source maps, XSS stringify)—typical Vue CLI build is trusted project CSS. Separate nested postcss@7.0.39 under @vue/component-compiler-utils is not the scanned 8.4.19 instance; upgrading the 8.x tree does not automatically fix 7.x. Bump via npm update postcss and verify npm run build.

Transitive via postcss (^1.0.2). DoS on malicious indexed source maps during build. postcss dependency range permits 1.2.2; lockfile refresh should pull it without overrides. Dev/build-time blast radius.
